newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Flughafen Wien slumps on resignation talk.
newsitem.headline: Flughafen Wien slumps on resignation talk.

text.p: Shares of Austrian airport operator Flughafen Wien declined as much as 6.2 percent on the Vienna stock exchange on Monday amid unconfirmed rumours one of the group's two chief executives had resigned.
In the last minutes of trading, the share was down 3.55 percent at 543 schillings, up from an earlier low of 528 schillings. Trading volumes were heavy with 200,500 shares changing hands.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips was down 0.22 percent at 1,213.87 at the same time.
"There are rumours that (one of the two) chief executives has resigned," said one trader.
The head of the company's non-executive supervisory board, Wolfgang Nolz, said he could not confirm the rumours. "I don't know anything about this," he told Reuters.
The contracts of Flughafen's two top executives, Gerhard Kastelitz and Franz Kotrba, come up for renewal in June. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
